selection: From each later development date 2026-08-25 through 2026-08-28, take the first two chronological BASE signals produced causally by the frozen detector and metadata. The rule and all eight cases were frozen before requesting quotes; signal outcomes and later price paths were not consulted.
question: On later exposed development dates, how often does the unchanged quote-anchored 100-share policy produce an executable entry, and how often does a +10% or +20% move remain after the first source-qualified SIP decision quote?
decision_quote: First quote from signal time through two minutes later with positive share sizes, uncrossed positive prices, midpoint spread <=0.8%, and Alpaca SIP provenance. The event timestamp is the historical decision anchor; receipt time is not asserted.

execution_label.rule: First bid-side barrier after a simulated executable fill; ambiguous same-timestamp barrier order and incomplete quote coverage remain unknown.

discovery_labels.same_session_bar_horizon: Regular-session close using already-saved one-minute bars, beginning with the first whole minute after the decision quote.
discovery_labels.rule: Measure whether the threshold is reached before the adverse barrier. A one-minute bar touching both is ambiguous. These are opportunity-recall outcomes, not executable returns.

retrieval.range: Signal time through 48 minutes later, ascending, one symbol per request.
retrieval.no_repeat_rule: Do not re-request a completed interval in this cycle. A capped or unavailable path is recorded as missing, not as a negative outcome.

comparison: Retain every frozen case and every scenario. Do not tune thresholds, omit missing cases, compute resolved-only expectancy as strategy profitability, open the final holdout, change live rules, execute orders, or deploy from this study.
